text: cable cut: M1-C3–M2-C4 (both ends see the link go down)
expected: Both routers see the link go down and withdraw its routes at once: customers routed over it should be back on another path within ~1-5 s. This is a backbone link between metros: traffic between them takes the way through the third metro.
Paths move back over the link within a few seconds, normally without loss.
